answer: Sunlight through a prism splits into seven colours, and so should a ballot's proof. Each ballot enters the garden through one narrow inlet, its credential split in seven spectral lines — device, stake, work, vouch, place, history, liveness — each by a different family. A farm cloning one gardener dies by the spectral-match check: two ballots sharing six lines burn together, $25 bonds slashed, $250,000 gone. Forging 10,000 ballots needs 10,000 spectra, each taking 40 minutes of verified checks and about $35 in stamps — $350,000 and 6,700 hours for a farm. One bulb fakes only grey.
